The Brief

One small packet.
Six reasons to care.

Silica gel is the most overlooked object in most people's homes — until the day it isn't. This project set out to give a genuinely unglamorous product a genuinely persuasive voice, built for the exact moment a customer needs it: a soaked phone, a monsoon-battered shoe rack, an archive of documents that can't be replaced.

Working across electronics, leather goods, home storage, records, fine jewellery and seasonal footwear, I directed the concept, prompt engineering, layout and message hierarchy for each creative — keeping a single brand system legible while letting each use-case speak in its own visual dialect.

The Collection

Six creatives, each tuned to a distinct customer moment — from panic to preservation.

SPECIMEN 01 / URGENCY

Wet Phone Rescue

Electronics

A split-frame built for the panic of the moment — problem and solution in a single glance, with the product doing the reassuring.

SPECIMEN 02 / PRESTIGE

Leather & Legacy

Leather Goods

Editorial styling and serif typography reposition a desiccant packet as an accessory-care essential, not an afterthought.

SPECIMEN 03 / ROUTINE

Wardrobe & Home

Home Storage

A calm, three-scene layout that turns a habitual chore — organising cabinets and closets — into a small act of care.

SPECIMEN 04 / TRUST

Records & Archives

Documents

Institutional blues and an archive-shelf setting speak directly to offices and families safeguarding what can't be reprinted.

SPECIMEN 05 / DESIRE

Fine Jewellery

Jewellery

Soft textiles, gold light and a single close-up let the product recede — the ad sells the feeling of things staying beautiful.

SPECIMEN 06 / SEASONAL

Monsoon Guide

Footwear · Seasonal

Built as a shareable how-to rather than a straight ad — timed to a weather moment when the need explains itself.

A single brand system, recoloured per use-case — so the collection reads as one campaign, not six.

The Approach

01

Concepting

Mapped six real customer moments for one product — from emergency to routine to seasonal — so every creative had a genuine reason to exist.

02

Direction & Prompting

Wrote and refined the visual prompts scene by scene, art-directing lighting, styling and composition rather than accepting a first pass.

03

Systemised Palette

Assigned each use-case its own colour language while holding typography and layout logic constant across the set.

04

Message Hierarchy

Ordered headline, benefit icons and CTA so each ad reads correctly in under two seconds — built for the scroll, not the studio.
